title: Energy Level Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The derived expression for the energy levels of the He+ ion must be correct.

title: Magnetic Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The calculation of the energy in the magnetic field for the l = 1 state must be accurate.

title: Angular Momentum Quantization
description: Important Criteria: The application of angular momentum quantization in the derivation must be clearly shown.

title: Centripetal Force Equation
description: Important Criteria: The correct use of the centripetal force equation in the derivation is necessary.

title: Magnetic Moment Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The derivation of the magnetic moment from the orbital motion must be included.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The response should check for consistent units throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: Consideration of limiting cases or special scenarios could enhance the response.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign errors in the energy expressions must be avoided.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that no critical factors are omitted in the final expressions.
